data.title: ChowChow Cloud Shareholders Back Reverse Split, Dual-Class Structure and Massive Capital Increase
data.description:
ChowChow Cloud International Holdings Ltd. ( (CHOW) ) has shared an announcement.

On September 14, 2026, ChowChow Cloud International Holdings Ltd. shareholders approved a 10-for-1 reverse share split of authorized, issued and unissued ordinary shares, with no fractional shares to be issued and directors empowered to resolve rounding via capitalizing reserves. Investors also backed the creation of dual-class stock with single-vote Class A shares and ten-vote Class B shares, together with a redesignation of existing issued and unissued shares into the new classes.

The meeting further endorsed a massive increase in authorized share capital to US$100 billion, enabling the issuance of up to 100 trillion shares split between the new A and B classes. Shareholders approved a second amended and restated memorandum and articles of association to reflect the capital changes and a lower threshold for written ordinary resolutions, and authorized the board to complete all related corporate and regulatory filings, consolidating management’s control and strategic flexibility.

data.title: JBS S.A. and VIVA to Form Joint Leather Venture JBS VIVA
data.description:
The latest update is out from JBS N.V. Shs Sponsored Brazilian Depositary Receipt Repr 1 Sh A ( (BR:JBSS32) ).

JBS S.A. has signed an Association Agreement with VIVA Holding to combine their leather production, processing and commercialization assets into a new jointly owned company, JBS VIVA, with each party holding 50% of the shares and sharing board control. Prior to closing, both sides will reorganize their structures to consolidate relevant leather operations into JBS Couros and VIVA, while excluding collagen and gelatin activities, certain international plants and non-core assets.

Under the deal, JBS VIVA will integrate JBS’s leather assets in Brazil and abroad with VIVA’s leather operations and chemical inputs business, creating a larger, more specialized player in the global leather supply chain. JBS S.A. and JBS VIVA will also enter reciprocal supply agreements for hides and leather by-products, reinforcing feedstock security for JBS’s gelatin and collagen operations, though completion of the transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions and timing is not guaranteed.

data.title: Safety Insurance clears key antitrust hurdle for MAPFRE merger
data.description:

On July 23, 2026, Safety Insurance Group entered into a merger agreement with MAPFRE U.S.A. Corp., under which a MAPFRE subsidiary will merge into Safety, leaving Safety as a wholly owned subsidiary of MAPFRE. A key regulatory milestone was reached when the Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust waiting period expired at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on September 14, 2026, clearing an important condition to closing, although the transaction still depends on additional customary regulatory approvals and shareholder processes.

Safety has filed a definitive proxy statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission in connection with the proposed merger, which was first mailed to shareholders around September 14, 2026.
